title: 固定ネット付き屋外卓球台
titleEn: Outdoor table tennis table with fixed net
description: 公園や屋外広場向けの単体卓球台。公称2.74×1.525 m・天板高さ0.76 mの青い天板、白線、固定式金属ワイヤーネット、テーパー付き鉱物系支柱、横梁・斜材・接地固定金具を造形。ラケット、球、競技場や利用者は含みません。静的装飾モデルで、競技規格認定や屋外構造安全性の検証は行っていません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）2.742 × 0.944 × 1.824 m、13,304三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: One outdoor table tennis table for parks and plazas: a nominal 2.74 × 1.525 m blue top at 0.76 m, painted boundaries and doubles line, fixed metal-wire net, tapered mineral piers, cross bearers, braces and anchor hardware. No bats, ball, court or people. Static decorative geometry, without sporting-standard certification or outdoor structural-safety validation. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 2.742 × 0.944 × 1.824 m; 13,304 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
